repo.description:
### Impact

An authenticated user can inject arbitrary RESP messages into the connection's response stream, potentially causing response desynchronization in connection-pool clients.

### Patches
https://github.com/dragonflydb/dragonfly/pull/7332

### Workarounds
Avoid using Dragonfly in multi-tenant environments.

### References
https://github.com/dragonflydb/dragonfly/issues/7328
repo.summary: RESP Protocol Injection via Lua redis.error_reply() in EvalSerializer
